name: Glucose syrup
aliases: glucose syrup, corn syrup, liquid glucose, glucose-fructose syrup, high fructose corn syrup, HFCS, fructose syrup, jarabe de glucosa, sirop de glucose
what_is: A sweet, thick liquid made by hydrolyzing plant starch into simple sugars.
why_botia: Glucose syrup is starch broken down into sugars, so it is absorbed quickly. The word "sugar" does not appear on the label, and when a product contains several sugars with different names, each one weighs less and none may appear among the first ingredients. WHO counts it as a free sugar.
can_1: Flag the ingredient as an added sugar.
can_2: Flag it as a free sugar under WHO criteria.
cannot_1: Verify the exact ratio of glucose to fructose unless specified by terms like high-fructose corn syrup.
cannot_2: Measure the amount of added sugars in grams directly from the text of the ingredient list.
